subject: Private deployment: platform fee smoothing & on-call credit options
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearharbor.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: platform fee smoothing & on-call credit options

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the runtime performance and we can see clear upside. Before we move to procurement, two questions from finance/SRE:

1) Platform fee timing: is there flexibility to amortize the platform fee over 12 months (rather than up-front) for an annual commit?
2) On-call buffer: our SREs want a reduced on-call retainer for the first 6 months while we migrate (we expect limited post-go-live incidents). Can Redwood provide a temporary credit for on-call/onboarding?

We pulled together an initial list of priorities and attached a short summary to this message (see CHB_migration_needs.pdf). Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearHarbor

Attachments: CHB_migration_needs.pdf (text summary)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearharbor.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: platform fee smoothing & on-call credit options

Tom — really appreciate the clear ask. I took this to commercial + solutions and we sketched three pragmatic approaches. I attached the pricing matrix and a first-pass SOW (CHB_Draft_SOW_v1.pdf). High level:

Option A — Standard: platform fee up-front, on-call retainer at full post-go-live rate. Fastest procurement.
Option B — Smoothing: amortize platform fee monthly for year-one with a small financing premium (1.5%). Provide a temporary 50% reduction on the on-call retainer for the first 3 months, then step up to 75% for months 4–6.
Option C — Migration credit: commit to a 12-month reserved capacity SKU and we provide a one-time migration credit that offsets the platform fee by 30% plus one month of waived on-call.

Quick notes: Karthik flagged a few technical constraints for aggressive fee reduction (see below). If you like, we can turn Option B into a short commercial term sheet to circulate to your procurement/legal.

Next step: can you confirm which option aligns best with ClearHarbor’s cashflow and internal SRE risk tolerance? If you prefer, we can run a short model with your team count and token estimates.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-vpc-pricing-matrix.xlsx, CHB_Draft_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@clearharbor.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: platform fee smoothing & on-call credit options

Quick technical context on credits and SLAs — we don't want to overpromise during migration. Two observations:

- If ClearHarbor opts for a heavily reduced on-call retainer (e.g., waived for 6 months), we should limit the SLA window for critical incidents to business hours for the same period. That prevents unreasonable on-call burden on our side while you finish validation testing.
- The amortization of the platform fee is fine commercially, but it ties us to a commit profile (we typically require a minimum reserved capacity anchor). If you can't commit to reserved nodes, the finance premium needs to reflect burst risk.

Suggested wording for SOW: temporary on-call credit described as a timebound concession with explicit escalation steps, and a clause that reverts to standard SLA after the migration window. I've drafted an example excerpt and added it to the SOW (oncall-tier-examples.docx).

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachment: oncall-tier-examples.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearharbor.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Legal - ClearHarbor <contracts@clearharbor.io>
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: platform fee smoothing & on-call credit options

Tom — putting a commercial proposal on the table that should simplify internal approvals at ClearHarbor. We recommend Option B as a balanced path; here are the specific term bullets we would include in a short-term commercial addendum:

• Platform fee amortization: Redwood invoices the platform fee over 12 monthly installments for year one (1.5% financing fee applied to the amortized balance).
• Temporary on-call credit: 50% credit to the on-call retainer for months 1–3, 25% credit for months 4–6 (explicitly timebound).
• Reserved capacity anchor: 6-month minimum reserved node commit (standard churn protections). If ClearHarbor converts to fully metered within 6 months, remaining amortized platform balance becomes due.
• Migration credit: we will provide a one-time $50k migration credit if ClearHarbor signs a 12-month reserved capacity SKU within 30 days.

We can produce a two-page term sheet and attach it to the SOW; I put a draft in Drive (link above). If procurement needs a single-line summary for finance approval: "12-month amortization with staged on-call credits and $50k migration credit for reserved commit."

If that looks good, we will route to Legal for redlines. Suggested timeline: commercial term sheet + SOW to ClearHarbor by EOD next Wednesday (2026-08-12).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearharbor.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Irene / Marissa — thanks, this is helpful and much easier to bring to finance. ClearHarbor is comfortable moving forward with Option B in principle, subject to:

1) The SOW reflecting the temporary SLA window change during migration (business-hours critical for months 1–3).
2) Contract language that makes the $50k migration credit contingent on the reserved capacity commit within 30 days.

We will ask Legal to redline the draft SOW and commercial term sheet. Can you send the commercial term sheet and the SOW with Karthik’s on-call excerpt by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12)? Procurement is ready to queue the PO once legal finishes redlines.

Appreciate the responsiveness — let’s get the draft over and we’ll aim to close next week.

—Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearHarbor
